result.reason: The redline largely tracks the preferred position: Client receives successor-assignment rights, TrueLink assignments require consent under a reasonableness standard and cannot be made to a Client competitor, and Client change of control creates no termination right. However, Client’s affiliate-assignment right remains limited to a “financially responsible” affiliate, whereas the playbook permits assignment to any affiliate. It also goes beyond the required position by prohibiting suspension and repricing and by adding reorganization to the successor carve-out. Those additions may alter rights beyond what is needed. Drafting is generally professional, though the clause inconsistently refers to assignments of “rights,” assignments generally, and assignment of the entire Agreement.
